items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I remember Carew saying that his work with the man--

ctx.x: His name is--I can't tell you--he's in St. Paul, Minnesota, he's worked with Rod Carew. I learned about it on a sport show. He worked with Carew on concentration which is very important in baseball, it's one of the principles.
I remember Carew saying that his work with the man--
It's Harvey Maizel. He also worked with the Minnesota Symphony.
